headline: Intesa Sanpaolo Plans Late November Launch for €33 Billion Monte Paschi Bid
summary: Intesa Sanpaolo is planning a late November launch for its €33 billion takeover bid for Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena.
why: Intesa Sanpaolo and Monte dei Paschi are major Italian banking institutions, and large consolidation deals reshape the European banking landscape.
